question: Which food has pH value between 2 and 3? This value makes it acidic.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lemon juice**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lemon juice** has a pH value between 2 and 3, making it highly acidic.
 
• Other juices like **apple juice**, **blackberry juice**, and **tomato juice** have higher pH values and are less acidic compared to lemon juice.
